newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Brent steady, NYMEX rebounds, watching APIs.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Brent steady, NYMEX rebounds, watching APIs.

text.p: Brent crude futures were steady in Asia in late trading Wednesday, while a modest technical bounce was supporting NYMEX.
April Brent on SIMEX was last traded at $19.22 per barrel, down two cents from London. London fell four cents overnight to $19.24 after breaching support at $19.00 to hit an intraday low of $18.93.
But NYMEX April was lending some support, rising 12 cents to $20.23 per barrel on ACCESS, after New York dropped 38 cents to $20.11 overnight.
Tom James, Asia-Pacific manager for natural resources at Credit Lyonnais Rouse, said London and New York overnight confirmed the bearish trend was intact.
Less than a three-million barrel build on the delayed API report would lend some support, he said.
New York market expectations were for a 3.5 million build on crude, a 1.5-million draw for distillates and a gasoline draw of 500,000 barrels.
